value.rationale: Exact loss of entrywise positivity despite spectral stability is a natural structural discretization boundary. The all-windmill quartic gives an exact cutoff and identifies precisely which entries fail, distinguishing stars, complete graphs and genuine clique-windmills. The negative-entry pattern is informative beyond routine scalar Padé stability.

limitations: Unweighted, equal-size blades, combinatorial Laplacian, completed two-stage Gauss-Legendre heat step only; not weighted graphs, arbitrary graph joins, internal stages, or multiple-step bounds.
